summary: Wrote spec/spec.yaml and spec/spec.md for counter8, an 8-bit up/down counter with synchronous active-low reset, enable and load. There are 13 typed requirements, each with a numeric acceptance criterion. Count resets to 0x00, wraps on overflow and underflow, and control priority is reset > load > enable. The 100 MHz clock on sky130A/sky130_fd_sc_hd is stated in the request. Schema validation and consistency checks have not been run by me; the runtime will run them.
assumptions: All inputs are synchronous to clk, so no synchronizers are needed.
I did not run tools or web research, and no tool output is claimed. Knowledge-base entries are used as the sources.
No bus or protocol (AMBA, SPI, I2C, etc.) is implied, because request.md mentions none.
No carry or overflow flag output is included because the request does not ask for one.
Port names (enable, load, up_down, load_data, count) are my choice because the request gives none. DEFAULT - needs G1 review.
Priority is reset > load > enable, and load takes effect even when enable=0. DEFAULT - needs G1 review.
Reset is active-low and named rst_n, following the S2S RTL checklist (synchronous active-low rst_n).
Reset value of count is 8'h00. DEFAULT - needs G1 review.
SKY130 PDK and sky130_fd_sc_hd versions are taken from kb-tk-003 (sky130A, high-density library). I did not verify the exact release tag in this task.
The counter is a self-contained block whose pins are plain synchronous digital signals, so no standard governs them.
The load data input and the up/down direction control are inferred from the phrase 'up/down counter with load'. The request does not name them.
The sky130A release is not pinned, as in the standards report.
Wrap (not saturate) on overflow and underflow. DEFAULT - needs G1 review.
up_down=1 means count up and 0 means count down. DEFAULT - needs G1 review.
open_issues: Does the customer want a carry/overflow output? It is not included.
Exact SKY130 PDK and library release/commit should be pinned by the flow owner. I have not confirmed it.
Is the load-while-disabled behavior (load works when enable=0) acceptable? It is a default awaiting G1 review.
Overflow/underflow behavior (wrap vs saturate) is unspecified (kb-fc-007). Proposed default: wrap. Mark 'DEFAULT - needs G1 review'.
Priority among reset, load, enable and direction is unspecified. Proposed default: reset > load > enable, with direction only used when counting. Needs G1 review.
Reset value of the count output is not stated. Proposed default: 8'h00 (needs G1 review). The reset style is stated as synchronous, with the active level unspecified.
STA corners are not specified. REQ-011 refers to the flow's configured signoff corners.
The sky130A PDK release is not pinned and needs a decision from the flow owner.
The timing target (100 MHz = 10 ns period) lacks I/O constraints and clock uncertainty, which belong to the spec/constraints agents.

messages.summary: No external interface standard applies to counter8: it is a standalone 8-bit up/down counter with only clock, synchronous reset, enable, load and data pins, and no bus, protocol, or serial interface. The only external references are the SKY130 PDK and the sky130_fd_sc_hd library (the implementation target, not an interface standard). No third-party IP is needed. The spec still has open behavioral gaps that Iris should close at G1.

self_assessment.reason: The spec follows the checklist and schema, but several behaviors are defaults awaiting G1 review. I could not run the schema validator here.
